_comment: Documented compat deltas. Each entry suppresses a matching DiffRecord from the active section of summary.md and surfaces it under '## Suppressed (known deltas)' with its reason + regressionTest. See docs/registry/api-compat-deltas.md.

deltas.reason: v3's updateCache is phase-aware: 200 + Git-refresh duration while git-sourced components remain (migration-status git>0), 410 Gone once fully migrated to the DB (git==0, with the Git resolver still parsing components). A db-mode compat candidate is fully migrated (auto-migrate -> git==0) so it returns 410 here; the git-mode candidate (no migration, git>0) returns 200 and matches baseline, so this delta does NOT appear in known-deltas-git.json (empty). baselineValue intentionally omitted: under parallel test load the V1 baseline can transport-fail this heavy operation (Git DSL re-clone) before the HTTP client's timeout — same root cause regardless of whether baseline answers 200 or transport-fails (0). id17 #3666 reproduced the transport-failure variant. Confirmed intentional 2026-05-15; updated for phase-aware 2026-06-01.
deltas.regressionTest: ComponentsRegistryServiceControllerUpdateCacheTest.git equal to zero retires the endpoint with 410 and does not re-read

deltas.reason: Symptom of the STATUS_CODE_DIFF entry above — when the V1 baseline transport-fails the heavy /updateCache call under parallel load, no response headers come back and only candidate (which answers 410 with a JSON ErrorResponse body) reports a content-type. Suppressed together with the status-code deprecation delta.
deltas.regressionTest: ComponentsRegistryServiceControllerUpdateCacheTest.git equal to zero retires the endpoint with 410 and does not re-read

deltas.reason: #256 stale-git bleed-through fix. For a DB-sourced project whose requested version is absent from the DB, the V1/git baseline can still serve a STALE VCSSettings as 200 from legacy DSL, while the v3 candidate routes by resolved component source (ComponentRoutingResolver.resolverForProject) and correctly returns 404. This delta only materialises when the smoke/trace set happens to probe a db-sourced project at a version git still stale-matches; baselineValue omitted because the baseline value is the stale 200 we are intentionally diverging from. The authoritative regression guard is the unit test (this entry is defensive documentation, same convention as the updateCache deltas above).
deltas.regressionTest: ComponentRoutingResolverStaleAndNotFoundTest.issue256_getVCSSettingForProject_dbSourcedMissingVersion_throwsNotFound_noGitBleed

deltas.reason: #256 stale-git bleed-through fix (Distribution counterpart of the vcs-settings entry above). DB-sourced project + version absent from DB: git baseline may serve a stale Distribution as 200; v3 candidate routes by resolved component source and returns 404. Authoritative guard is the unit test; this entry is defensive documentation.
deltas.regressionTest: ComponentRoutingResolverStaleAndNotFoundTest.issue256_getDistributionForProject_dbSourcedMissingVersion_throwsNotFound_noGitBleed

deltas.reason: ADR-021 effective Jira display name (2026-09): JiraComponent.displayName now resolves `jiraDisplayName ?: displayName` instead of jiraDisplayName alone, so a component declaring only a componentDisplayName renders its own name where the 2.0.87 baseline rendered null (and the downstream plugin fell through to the shared Jira project name). Affects the components in that shape. Applied on the DB resolver path only, so known-deltas-git.json stays empty and the deploy-without-migration invariant is untouched. Raw layer. Covers $.component.displayName (jira-component / project-version) and $.jiraComponentVersion.component.displayName (component-version DetailedComponent). STRUCTURAL_DIFF, not VALUE_DIFF: compareRaw only emits STRUCTURAL_DIFF, and null->string is a TYPE_MISMATCH in JsonShape. Raw layer only: the TYPED layer is handled by the Adr021DisplayName field comparator in Comparators.compareDto (a messagePattern cannot work there — ignoringCollectionOrder reports 'Top level actual and expected objects differ' for the Set-shaped endpoints), pinned by Adr021DisplayNameCompatTest including its negative cases.
deltas.regressionTest: JiraDisplayNameFallbackTest.falls back to component display name

deltas.reason: ADR-021 effective Jira display name (2026-09): JiraComponent.displayName now resolves `jiraDisplayName ?: displayName` instead of jiraDisplayName alone, so a component declaring only a componentDisplayName renders its own name where the 2.0.87 baseline rendered null (and the downstream plugin fell through to the shared Jira project name). Affects the components in that shape. Applied on the DB resolver path only, so known-deltas-git.json stays empty and the deploy-without-migration invariant is untouched. Raw layer, the Set-shaped version-range endpoints (one element per range). RESIDUAL RISK (unverifiable without a live baseline): RawArraySorters.jiraComponentVersionRangeKey tie-breaks colliding (componentName, versionRange) pairs with a canonical key over the WHOLE element, which includes component.displayName, while canonicalizeRangeKeyedArray bails out on the duplicate-range case. Inside such a collision group this change can reorder elements between stands and surface STRUCTURAL_DIFF at $[N].<other-field> paths that this anchored pattern will NOT match. If the gate reports unclassified structural diffs on these endpoints, that is the cause — widen deliberately rather than blanket-suppressing the endpoint. Raw layer only: the TYPED layer is handled by the Adr021DisplayName field comparator in Comparators.compareDto (a messagePattern cannot work there — ignoringCollectionOrder reports 'Top level actual and expected objects differ' for the Set-shaped endpoints), pinned by Adr021DisplayNameCompatTest including its negative cases.
deltas.regressionTest: JiraDisplayNameFallbackTest.falls back to component display name

deltas.reason: ADR-021 + TD-022 (2026-09): JiraComponentVersionRange.equals/hashCode omit componentName, so components whose version range and Jira configuration are identical collapse into ONE element of the returned Set. A component declaring only a componentDisplayName had component.displayName = null, which is precisely what made it identical to its siblings; ADR-021 resolves that name and the collapsed component reappears. The candidate is therefore a STRICT SUPERSET of the baseline, and the addition is a recovery, not a regression. This entry does NOT accept an arbitrary superset: the 'TD-022 RECOVERY CONFIRMED' marker is emitted by Adr021RangeRecovery only when nothing is lost, every addition's componentName is absent from the baseline ranges yet present in the baseline's /components inventory (the independent evidence that it existed and was merely hidden — without it the rule refuses), a baseline twin exists under the REAL equality contract (versionRange + component modulo displayName + vcsSettings; distribution is excluded because Distribution.equals compares nothing — see TD-023), and that twin's displayName was absent while the addition's is not. Any other size difference carries 'NOT A TD-022 RECOVERY: <reason>' instead and stays active. db-mode only (the rule refuses in git-mode), and the typed layer removes the very same confirmed elements rather than suppressing its record, so a co-occurring regression still fails. Affected component keys are withheld from this public repo; they are named in the build's summary.md.
deltas.regressionTest: Adr021RangeRecoveryTest (9 cases: the confirmed shape plus loss / no-twin / already-named-twin / duplicate / nameless / git-mode refusals)

deltas.reason: ONB-001 VCS entry placement (rev. 3, 2026-09): VCS roots carry sourcePath and checkoutDirectory (V8__ back-fills checkoutDirectory = name after the first entry of multi-root rows; the placement import and the Portal set either on any root, [0] included), and the v2 VersionControlSystemRootDTO serializes them NON_NULL. The baseline has no placement, so a migrated candidate adds them. Only additions are suppressed: a changed value is a VALUE_DIFF, not a STRUCTURAL_DIFF. Typed layer: Comparators.buildAssertion forgives baseline-null -> value on these fields. See docs/registry/api-compat-deltas.md.
deltas.regressionTest: GitVsDbValidationTest.VAL-003a multi-root placement is the known difference
